================================================================================
  PLATFORM COVERAGE:
================================================================================

Test Platforms:
  ✅ CPU (Linux/macOS/Windows)       - env_cpu.yaml    via ci.yml
  ✅ MPS (macOS M1/M2/M3)            - env_mps.yml     via ci.yml
  ✅ CUDA (Linux with GPU)            - env_cuda.yml    via ci.yml

Each platform fully tested with pytest on GitHub Actions!


================================================================================
  WORKFLOW SUMMARY:
================================================================================

1️⃣  quick-test.yml
   ├─ Trigger: Every push and PR
   ├─ Duration: 3-5 minutes ⚡ (FAST)
   ├─ Platform: Ubuntu with CPU PyTorch
   └─ Best for: Rapid feedback during development

2️⃣  ci.yml
   ├─ Trigger: Push to main/steven/develop, PRs
   ├─ Duration: 15-20 minutes
   ├─ Platforms: CPU (Ubuntu), MPS (macOS), CUDA (Ubuntu)
   ├─ Includes: Linting checks
   └─ Best for: Comprehensive multi-platform testing

3️⃣  env-test.yml
   ├─ Trigger: Changes to environment files (env_*.yml)
   ├─ Duration: 10-15 minutes
   ├─ Tests: Each environment independently
   └─ Best for: Ensuring environment files stay valid


================================================================================
  WHAT GETS TESTED:
================================================================================

✅ Python 3.12+ installation

   • numpy              • ipykernel
✅ Basic tensor operations
✅ Device detection (CUDA/MPS/CPU)


================================================================================
  QUICK START (3 STEPS):
================================================================================

Step 1: Commit and push files
   $ git add .github/
   $ git commit -m "Add GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows"
   $ git push origin steven

Step 2: Monitor first run
   → Go to GitHub repository
   → Click "Actions" tab
   → Watch workflows execute

Step 3: Add status badges (optional)
   → Copy badges from .github/BADGES.md
   → Paste into README.md
   → Commit and push

  WORKFLOW TRIGGERS & TIMING:

Event                    │ Workflows Triggered   │ Total Time

PR to main/develop       │ ci, env-test          │ 20-25 min
Edit env_*.yml files     │ env-test              │ 10-15 min
Manual trigger           │ Any workflow          │ Varies
